# Vendored MathJax New Computer Modern font

This directory contains the CommonHTML assets used by the site's self-hosted MathJax renderer.

- Package: `@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font`
- Version: `4.1.3`
- Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font/v/4.1.3>
- License declared by the package: Apache-2.0
- `chtml.js` SHA-256: `8c8af66b784c3c1c406a3339aa38e13ebc9ae6aab5dc6b235651fcac5af513a1`

The project-level MathJax license is reproduced in `assets/vendor/mathjax/LICENSE`.
